description: Plain-English definition of a freight market index, ratio, or charge from the FreightFA glossary: OTRI, OTVI, load-to-truck ratio, NTI, Cass Freight Index, RCAF, fuel surcharge, freight class, detention and demurrage, DIM weight, bill of lading, deadhead, accessorials, linehaul, and more. Returns who publishes it, how to read it, and why it matters. Omit the term to list every entry with its link. Does not count toward the allowance.

term.description: The term or abbreviation, e.g. 'OTRI' or 'linehaul rate'. Omit or null to list every term.
